description: This source file contains unit tests for ADO.NET client stream functionality across different databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It defines specific test classes for each database type and a base class that handles shared setup and configuration logic, including initializing database testing environments, configuring client and silo builders, and executing test scenarios related to stream producer and consumer behavior when clients are dropped.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: AdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for ADO.NET client stream tests, providing setup, configuration, and common test methods.

classes.name: TestClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder with ADO.NET stream options and messaging timeout.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder with ADO.NET stream options and grain storage.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Runs the test verifying producer behavior when the client is dropped.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Runs the test verifying consumer behavior when the client is dropped.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up relational storage and test runner.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with specific silo and client builder configurators.
